title: PM-KISAN
description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Government of India scheme that provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families as defined under the scheme guidelines.
benefits: Eligible beneficiaries receive financial support of Rs. 6,000 per year, paid in three equal instalments.
application: Farmers can register and access PM-KISAN services through the official government portal.

title: National Scholarship Portal
description: The National Scholarship Portal is a government platform for students to access and apply for scholarships.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the specific scholarship scheme and its published guidelines.
benefits: Students can find eligible scholarships, submit applications and track their scholarship applications.
application: Students can register and apply through the National Scholarship Portal.

title: Aadhaar
description: Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identification number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) to eligible residents of India.
eligibility: Aadhaar enrolment is available to residents of India according to UIDAI rules.
benefits: Aadhaar can be used as a digital identity document and for authentication and access to various services.
application: Residents can enrol for Aadhaar at an authorised Aadhaar enrolment centre.

title: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao is a Government of India initiative focused on valuing the girl child and improving awareness and outcomes related to girls.
eligibility: The initiative is implemented for the welfare and empowerment of girls and women through awareness and coordinated government action.
benefits: It promotes the protection, education and empowerment of the girl child.
application: It is primarily an awareness and implementation programme rather than a direct cash-benefit application scheme.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account
description: Sukanya Samriddhi Account is a government-backed savings scheme designed for the financial future of a girl child.
eligibility: The account can generally be opened for a girl child subject to the scheme rules and applicable age conditions.
benefits: It provides a government-backed savings option intended to support the financial needs of a girl child.
application: The account can be opened through authorised banks and post offices according to the scheme rules.

title: National Social Assistance Programme
description: The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) is a Government of India welfare programme providing social assistance to eligible beneficiaries, particularly vulnerable persons.
eligibility: Eligibility varies according to the individual NSAP component and applicable government guidelines.
benefits: The programme provides social assistance through components covering areas such as old age, widow and disability support.
application: Applications and implementation are generally handled through the relevant state or local government authorities.

title: Public Distribution System
description: The Public Distribution System (PDS) is a government system through which eligible households receive specified food commodities through authorised fair price shops.
eligibility: Eligibility and ration-card categories are determined under applicable government food-security rules.
benefits: Eligible households can receive subsidised food commodities through the PDS.
application: Citizens can apply for or manage ration-card services through the appropriate state food and civil supplies department.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) is a Government of India skill-development initiative designed to provide industry-relevant skill training and certification.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the applicable PMKVY training programme and its guidelines.
benefits: Eligible participants can receive skill training and certification through approved training arrangements.
application: Interested candidates can find relevant training opportunities through official Skill India channels.

title: Emergency Response Support System 112
description: 112 is India's single emergency response number for people who need immediate assistance during an emergency.
eligibility: The emergency service is available to people in India who require emergency assistance.
benefits: People can use 112 to seek emergency assistance for situations requiring services such as police, fire or medical help.
application: No application is required. In an emergency, a person can contact the 112 emergency service.

title: myScheme
description: myScheme is a Government of India platform that helps citizens discover government schemes and understand their eligibility and application information.
eligibility: Citizens can use the platform to discover schemes based on information relevant to them.
benefits: It helps users find government schemes and provides information about scheme benefits, eligibility and application processes.
application: Users can visit the myScheme platform and provide relevant information to discover suitable government schemes.
